endpoint_coverage_gate.ports: Every nonclock input bit including rst_n explicit input delay0; every output bit output delay0 under core_clk, load literal3.898 and fanout32 retained. Identity-set equality required.
endpoint_coverage_gate.exceptions: Exactly false_path -from rst_n. Enumerate affected startpoint/endpoint pairs and reasons. A reset-excepted path never waives other functional paths to that endpoint. No blanket IO false paths, multicycle or extra exceptions.
endpoint_coverage_gate.all_endpoints: Enumerate every functional timing endpoint and every applicable SS max/FF min check independently of path reports. Reconcile each to constrained check, exact reset-origin exception, or explicitly reviewed structural non-path reason. Missing, duplicate, unmatched and unexplained records refuse qualification.
endpoint_coverage_gate.other_checks: Native unconstrained/floating paths, missing delays, unclocked pins, multiple clocks, timing loops, latch/async recovery-removal checks and disabled arcs: zero unexplained omissions; original reset scope retained.
endpoint_coverage_gate.terminal_verdict: Full SS setup and FF hold each zero violating paths and nonnegative worst slack; zero DRC, antenna, slew, cap and fanout violations; complete endpoint coverage. TT and placement estimates pathfinding only. Process0 alone never PASS.
